rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person who is lively, cheerful, and peppy.

example.english: Their daughter is so exuberant that she livens up the whole house.
example.traditional: 佢個女一見到人就咁活潑，成屋都熱鬧晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 neoi5 jat1 gin3 dou2 jan4 zau6 gam3 wut6 put3 sing4 uk1 dou1 jit6 naau6 saai3

rows.note: Choose this when the energetic or vigorous side is more important than cheerfulness.

example.english: Even after exercising all day, they are still exuberant.
example.traditional: 做完成日運動，佢仲係咁有活力。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 sing4 jat6 wan6 dung6 keoi5 zung6 hai6 gam3 jau5 wut6 lik6

rows.note: Use this for the cheerful, upbeat personality side, especially when physical energy is not the focus.

example.english: They have an exuberant personality and face even sad things with a smile.
example.traditional: 佢個人好開朗，就算遇到唔開心嘅事都會笑住面對。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hoi1 long5 zau6 syun3 jyu6 dou3 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3 si6 dou1 wui5 siu3 zyu6 min6 deoi3
